newsitem.title: USA: U.S. energy prices ease on ACCESS with little news.
newsitem.headline: U.S. energy prices ease on ACCESS with little news.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices eased in early ACCESS trade with activity light as traders waited for significant news following the early week tensions between Iraq and the United States.
October NYMEX crude traded $23.41 a barrel, off three cents from the settle. A razor thin 110 lots changed hands.
October gasoline lost 0.21 cent to reach 64.20 cents a gallon on a thin 39 lots.
October heating oil trimmed 0.08 cent from the day session's settle to trade at 64.95 cents on 49 lots.
